report.title: Daily research report
report.subtitle: Written at 06:00 (Bogotá): the platform's data always; web research with sources when keys exist.
report.noClaims: No claims: no web search configured, or nothing published about these matches. A claim without a source is never shown as fact.
report.notYet: No report for this day yet: it is written at 06:00 (Bogotá), or when you press “Write now”.

grade.help: Confirmed: a dated official source, or two independent outlets. Reported: one reputable outlet. Rumour: anything else. The server can only lower the grade the AI proposes, never raise it.

flags.title: Flags on the picks
flags.subtitle: Flags only: the reviewer cannot change a probability, a price or a pick. The rules always run; the AI only with keys and on sourced claims.

usage.title: Every run, with its cost
usage.subtitle: Tokens and cost are recorded on every call; the monthly cap is checked before each one.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.daily_report: Daily report: every day from 06:00 (Bogotá), and on demand.
schedule.pick_review: Pick review: every hour on today's and tomorrow's sets.
schedule.research_v2: Research V2: weekly (Monday 04:20) when the code changed or four weeks passed.

evolution.memoryHelp: Each topic's current finding; earlier ones are kept as superseded, never deleted.

propose.title: Propose an experiment
propose.subtitle: A proposal stays Proposed until you decide it, like any other.

evolution.due: The weekly research would run now: {reason}.
evolution.notDue: The weekly research is not needed: same code and under four weeks.

today.title: What this is today
today.body: Every 30 minutes the decision layer builds the context packet of each upcoming match (with the source of every figure), reviews the selections that pass the value filter and stores one analysis per match. Every day, after the results, it writes post-mortems and memory, and proposes hypotheses only on sufficient evidence.
today.never: No result changes a rule, a threshold, a model or a pick by itself. Until the AI's shadow gate passes (and you switch enforce on), its reviews filter nothing users see.
today.futureTitle: Future architecture (not built: needs your approval and a provider account)

future.f1: OBSERVE: results, prices, closes and new data.
future.f2: MEASURE: metrics against the market (log loss, Brier, CLV) with intervals.
future.f3: AI RESEARCHES: reads the database (read-only) and cited web sources.
future.f4: AI PROPOSES: a hypothesis with its evidence; never a direct change.
future.f5: ISOLATED EXPERIMENT: in research, on MODEL_READY data.
future.f6: BACKTEST: walk-forward, leakage-free, against the de-vigged close.
future.f7: PROSPECTIVE SHADOW: shadow picks, invisible to users.
future.f8: COMPARISON WITH THE CHAMPION: same period, same matches.
future.f9: PROPOSAL: a report with the evidence and the risk.
future.f11: PROMOTION: only then does production change, versioned and reversible.

today.futureNote: Never: "bad result → the AI changes production automatically". The AI will have no write access to production.

evolution.noAuto: There is no "activate automatically" here. The AI and the system only propose; you decide: REJECT, INVESTIGATE or APPROVE EXPERIMENT. An approved experiment goes through backtest and shadow, and only with its gate passed can you PROMOTE it yourself.

findings.subtitle: What the results taught (the AI's memory).

evolution.hypothesesHelp: A hypothesis never changes production: it is investigated, tested in backtest and shadow, and only you promote it.

promote.help: The experiment's gate passed. Promoting records your decision; the change ships later as its own version. Type {word} to confirm.

loop.s1: OBSERVE: a result (research V2, the daily audit, the prospective evaluation, a match post-mortem).
loop.s2: MEMORY: it is stored with its evidence, its sources and the version that produced it.
loop.s3: HYPOTHESIS: where the evidence points somewhere, the system, the AI or you propose a hypothesis.
loop.s4: ADMIN: only you reject it, ask to investigate it or approve an experiment. None of that changes a rule.
loop.s5: EXPERIMENT and BACKTEST: it runs in research and is judged by the same gate as every model.
loop.s6: SHADOW and MARKET: what passes its backtest is followed in shadow against the market before anyone sees it.
loop.s7: EVALUATION: the result is judged against its gate and kept with the hypothesis.
loop.s8: PROMOTION: nothing reaches users without a passed gate AND your explicit promotion. The AI never promotes.

shadow.empty: No shadow evaluation yet: it is computed every day from finished matches.
shadow.help: The model alone against model + AI (without what it rejected) and against the market. The AI may only filter if what it rejects does significantly worse, without losing closing-line value or calibration.
